note: Produced by running the real fusion engine. Do not hand-edit — re-run the generator instead.

scenarios.name: text_only_neutral
scenarios.description: Plainest case. Text mode, nothing notable in the message.

scenarios.name: text_only_joy
scenarios.description: Strong positive from text alone. Note dominant_emotion refines to 'joy'.

scenarios.name: text_only_sadness
scenarios.description: Negative from text alone. Guards the label-mapping regression where 'my car broke down' used to come back as happy.

scenarios.name: voice_and_text_agree
scenarios.description: Voice mode. Transcript and vocal tone point the same way, so confidence is higher.

scenarios.name: conflict_masked_anger
scenarios.description: THE IMPORTANT ONE. Smiling face over an angry voice. The user says they are fine and they are not. Fusion re-weights toward the voice.

scenarios.name: conflict_suppressed_frustration
scenarios.description: Flat face, angry voice — someone holding a professional expression.

scenarios.name: conflict_internal_sadness
scenarios.description: Sad face, level voice. The one conflict type that trusts the FACE more.

scenarios.name: low_confidence_disagreement
scenarios.description: All three signals disagree and none is confident. The LLM should treat a payload like this as weak evidence, not a firm read.

scenarios.name: no_speech_detected
scenarios.description: Silence, or a transcript filtered as a Whisper hallucination. user_input.text is an EMPTY STRING — the LLM must handle this.
